components.text: All used on site, before degradation, tax, finance and roof rent. Your case is reworked from your bills and contract.

footnote: Source: Jiangsu DRC bidding notice (2025-11-11), CPIA PV roadmap (2024-2025 edition), The Paper (2026-08-18)
notes: This is the account for one megawatt, with a source for each input. Output uses the parameter in Jiangsu's official bidding notice: an average of 1,080 hours a year for this kind of plant over the last three years, on the AC side, so 1 MW makes 1.08 million kWh. The price replaced is RMB 0.45, a press-reported statistic: the average Jiangsu price between 9:00 and 15:00 was RMB 0.78 in May 2025 and RMB 0.45 in May 2026. Cost and O&M are CPIA's 2024 figures for commercial and industrial rooftop systems: RMB 2.70 per watt to build and RMB 0.046 per watt a year for basic maintenance. With all the power used on site, the bill falls by RMB 486,000 a year. Less RMB 46,000 of O&M, that is about RMB 440,000 net, and the RMB 2.7 million pays back in about 6.1 years. That is a simple payback, before panel degradation, tax, finance and roof rent. One caveat on units: if the RMB 2.70 per watt is priced on the DC side while the 1,080 hours are AC, CPIA's 1:1.25 DC-to-AC ratio would stretch the payback by about a quarter.
